note: What the create flow does with each part of a detailed prompt (the brief's `story` block). status: made (in the game), closest (a nearer thing is made, named here), not_made (reported with the fix route). Read by `create_flow vocab` and `plan`, and by the not-applied list of every result. A story with 3 or more places gets one room per place (64 is a build safety ceiling; outdoor rooms joined by gates, indoor rooms through doorways); with 0-2 places the flow builds two rooms (an outdoor entry and one interior).

fields.title: the game title
fields.player: the player's name (the body is the pack's public cast)
fields.cast: named people with a role (npc, companion, rival, suspect, captive, traitor, enemy, boss); people stand in their `place` (up to 4 per outdoor room, 3 per indoor room) with a talk action; enemy/boss fight in their `place` (the last boss is the final boss)
fields.places: each place becomes a room when there are 3 or more (the first outdoor place is the entry and the hub; `about` is the line shown on entering); past the 64-room safety ceiling places become named story spots, listed in the result. With 0-2 places: first outdoor = entry, first indoor = inside
fields.rooms: optional: how many rooms to build (default: one per place; 2 keeps the two-room game)
fields.keys: optional: keys [{name, place, opens}]: each key lies in its place and the door into the place it opens needs it (3+ places)
fields.item: the thing collected (name; `place` for a long story, default the final fight room); in the two-room game it is in the inside room
fields.beats: ordered scenes: each is a talk (who) or a story spot (place) with its text; each needs the one before; `when` puts beats on a story clock that moves on with them
fields.quests: journal lines done when: beat N, talk NAME, item, fight, course, choice, end
fields.door_lock: the door into the inside room opens only after: beat N or talk NAME (all earlier beats must be in the entry room)
fields.choice: one question with 2-4 answers asked by a cast member after the last beat; the right answer lets you finish, a wrong one ends the game with the lose text
fields.waves: fight waves, e.g. [2, 3] (1-4 waves of 1-3 enemies); the boss comes alone after the last wave
fields.course: timed course: seconds (10-600) and 2-5 named checkpoints, run in the entry room before you can finish
fields.lose: shown when a wrong choice is made; a lost fight or course restarts at the checkpoint instead
fields.mechanics: every gameplay word of the prompt, including no combat / no puzzles; each one is matched below

mechanics.what: a fight in the inside room (melee enemies; losing restarts at the checkpoint); it guards the item
the boss (cast role boss) comes alone after the last wave, named, with more health; it is a melee fighter, not a phased boss
a timed course in the entry room with story.course checkpoints and seconds; running out of time restarts it
the captive (cast role captive) is the thing collected: free them in the inside room and they follow you out
story.choice: one question with 2-4 answers; right wins, wrong ends with the lose text
story.door_lock: the inside door opens after a beat or a talk
each person gets a talk action with their `says` line; beats with `who` are spoken by them
a beat spoken by the traitor (role traitor); the traitor does not change sides at runtime unless also named as the boss
get the item in the inside room and bring it out (the two-room collect and return)
one room per story place (3+ places), or two rooms, with story spots in order

mechanics.closest: story.door_lock (the inside door opens after a beat) and/or story.choice (pick the right answer)
mechanics.fix: hand-author a STORY 1.3 puzzle (docs/PUZZLES.md, skill hermes64-gameplay-modules)
